build.buildCommand: npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund && npm cache clean --force && sleep 1 && find artifacts -type d -name .vite -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true && npm run predeploy --skip-env-check && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: NODE_ENV=production node scripts/ensure-db-ready.mjs && NODE_ENV=production node --enable-source-maps artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs
